Hello everyone. Erg Explorer dev ( https://ergexplorer.com ) here. Thank you @NoahErgo for letting me know about this group.

This is the first update about this project here. I'll try to keep it short.

1. Setup a public repo here: https://github.com/AcoSmrkas/ErgExplorer
2. Added transaction view page, along with links to transaction pages in wallet address view
3. Update responsive style for mobile devices
4. Updated search form to include address/transaction dropdown (i know having magic search that guesses if its tx/addresss/block is cool, but this is faster and safer for now)
5. Updated htaccess url rewrites to match official Ergo explorer URLs 1:1 (eg. https://explorer.ergoplatform.com/addresses/9fLXRjthKecc7LsHyQAF9w2DfqVbsFxsHqUBpz2ouBPYRmaBxfT -> https://ergexplorer.com/addresses/9fLXRjthKecc7LsHyQAF9w2DfqVbsFxsHqUBpz2ouBPYRmaBxfT and https://explorer.ergoplatform.com/transactions/b6f9122f4b7663f4d22a8999b2eb1330a185dc5e4ce3a7004f8cf3b5220ce5b7 -> https://ergexplorer.com/transactions/b6f9122f4b7663f4d22a8999b2eb1330a185dc5e4ce3a7004f8cf3b5220ce5b7
6. Added wallet address QR code in address view

Latest updates about Erg Explorer: https://medium.com/@ergexplorer/erg-explorer-development-update-charting-the-course-75062b6f291c

In short:
1. Implemented issued tokens list
2. Implemented block and token details views
3. Updated search to include search by token id and block id

Next:
1. NFT previews
2. Try and present smart contract transactions information better
3. Visual overhaul and light theme (learned that some people actually have issues with dark themes)

When using ErgoPay. How do I restrict user from selecting to process it with multiple addresses?

edit: SOLVED
This pre-check is a POST request to the URL with the #P2PK_ADDRESS# placeholder replaced by the keyword "multiple_check". If this request is successful (2xx return code), users can select multiple addresses.
